title: Kraken Witch Portal
description: A demonic green-skinned witch with purple eyes, black horns, and a red cloak emerges from glowing green liquid inside a large circular metallic portal frame. She holds a lit green candle while two pirate ships sail on the water; one is a detailed sailing vessel, the other a simple line drawing. Behind her is a cracked moon, purple smoke, ruined purple structures, and a distant Ferris wheel under an orange sky.
prompt: A demonic green witch with purple glowing eyes, black curved horns, and red cloak rises from glowing green liquid inside a large circular metallic porthole frame dripping with blue ooze and hanging ornate keys. She holds a tall melting green candle with a bright flame. Two sailing ships float nearby, one fully rendered pirate vessel and one simple white line drawing. Cracked moon in orange sky with purple smoke, ruined purple buildings, and a distant Ferris wheel in the background.
